definition.description: The Seifert‑fibered complement of the chosen structure provides a natural decomposition into base and fibers, enabling harmonic analysis. Paradigms may overlay additional layers of meaning (e.g., Information, Spiritual, Material).

formalism.description: The harmonic structure inherited from the Seifert‑fibered complement of T(19,2) (or any structure whose complement is Seifert‑fibered).
formalism.mathematical_foundation: For the default T(19,2) knot, S³ \ T(19,2) is Seifert‑fibered over a disk with cone points of orders 19 and 2.

quantum_depth.role: Depth of resolution, corresponds to winding around the order‑19 cone point.

resonant_harmonic.role: Complexity of harmonics, corresponds to winding around the order‑2 cone point.

phase_factor.role: Relative alignment of the two winding numbers; quantized to the 38th roots of unity.

combined_state.role: Complete resonant state; in closed systems, the sum of Ψ over all nodes must be real (phase cancellation).

resonant_states.definition: Special (n,m) combinations where φ is rational (i.e., n/19 + m/2 is an integer or half‑integer).

constraint: Any valid Factor must define resonance parameters (n,m) consistent with the chosen structure's complement. The phase φ must be a 38th root of unity.
